target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: The township is the direct operator and direct beneficiary of a searchable, citation-backed zoning assistant tied to its new code draft.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: The trustees are a strong influence layer because they own the modernization story and can benefit from a public-facing code portal that reduces friction.

actual_brand_research.current_observation: A formal Saybrook-specific visual identity pack has not yet been assembled in the repo. The first pass should use a restrained township-government and public-document visual system, drawing from public-site cues, posted draft-document context, and compact civic intake patterns rather than invented branding.
actual_brand_research.document_opportunity: The newly published zoning draft is now present in the repo as a clean 164-page tagged PDF, which should inform both the interface structure and the retrieval/indexing pipeline.
actual_brand_research.affiliation_guardrail: The product should look trustworthy and township-aware without claiming official endorsement or implying that a request is formally filed unless the backend really submits into a township-owned destination.

brandkit_for_mvp.name: Saybrook Zoning Clerk
brandkit_for_mvp.tagline: Ask zoning questions, review cited draft sections, and prepare a township-ready request draft.
brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: A township-specific zoning guidance and request-prep assistant for Saybrook — built to turn a long draft code PDF into a searchable, citation-backed civic intake utility with a compact handoff into formal request drafting.

ui_priorities: clear navigation for common zoning tasks
compact formal request flow after Q&A
optional supporting image upload before handoff
compact civic header instead of a large hero
avoid: claims of official filing or approval
request_flow_feel: structured review card before contact submission
supporting-photo upload framed for staff context
visible notice that township staff make final determinations

implementation_recommendations.clone_strategy: Use `zoning` as the parent and create a Saybrook-specific child clone rather than overwriting the county-oriented parent.
must_change: Swap county identity for Saybrook-specific identity
Replace broad multi-jurisdiction framing with township-specific language
Bind retrieval to the Saybrook code draft as the primary corpus
Ensure all trust/citation surfaces reference the Saybrook draft explicitly
Design the main CTA path around ask -> cite -> formalize request
Frame uploads as supporting materials for township review
asset_gaps: Any township-approved visual marks or color references
Confirmed public office-hours wording if available
